resources.string: Full-screen ringtone alerts for incoming calls
Controls and elapsed time during an active phone call
Shows live status and controls while recording audio
Shows auto-recording standby status and Android restriction alerts
Android blocks silent background mic start when another dialer is active. Tap here to start recording.

1. Default Phone App & Recording: Setting Narendra Phone as your Default Phone App routes incoming and outgoing calls through its real In-Call Dialer so Auto & Manual recording can start directly when a call is picked up.

2. Two-Way Audio Reality: On Android 10–15+, standard apps do not receive privileged CAPTURE_AUDIO_OUTPUT permission unless granted by the OEM/system. When restricted, this app records via your microphone and provides a 1-tap Speakerphone toggle on the call screen so the caller can also be heard.

3. Legal Consent & Privacy: Always comply with local recording consent laws. Recordings and call logs stay strictly on your device.
